main_body: wooden cottage with sloped thatch roof
top_band: yellow-gold layered thatch roof slope from row 0 to row 36
evidence: The sloped thatch roof forms a clear 37-row top band (rows 0-36) with a bright front edge highlight on row 35 and dark overhanging eave shadow on rows 37-39 above the 27-row wooden front wall (rows 37-63). The door and window are inset with dark framing.

style.evidence: The thatch roof and wooden walls have rich, multi-step shading (5-6 tones on both straw and wood) with detailed plank and straw-bundle texturing and no flat fills. However, unlike the Beodeul reference buildings which use dark brown/burgundy material tones on roof edges and walls, the candidate uses a heavy, nearly pure black outline along the roof slopes and vertical wall edges.
